stress.adaptive_block_rule: First B=8; thereafter B=16 when the immediately preceding CLOSED block score is <0.5, else B=4. This uses past closed state only and freezes B before current outcomes.

contract_checks: Every closed block score was appended to process_cs with weight 1 and exposure_cs with frozen planned_size/B_cap.
Future B adaptation used prior closed block score only; current block outcomes never changed B or exposure weight.
Realized completed count was not used as exposure weight even when outage/deadline caused missing slots.

Crash/recovery replay rebuilt both V3 channels from the same closed journal and reproduced both endpoints, both e-values at their unsafe tolerances, and the threshold-20 joint IUT decision exactly in all tested snapshots.
The stress included both joint-safe and joint-not-safe snapshots so replay equality was not tested only on one decision state.
scope_guards: tau=.8 is deliberately chosen to exercise both sides of the joint decision in a short synthetic campaign; it is not a recommended production tolerance.
This validates implementation/replay semantics under the tested adaptive-block rule, not the underlying statistical theorem by simulation.
Predictable adaptation from past blocks is permitted by the stored contract; no current-outcome-dependent realized weight was introduced.
